Summary

Keep the edges that matter

Whole-slide graphs connect every tissue patch to its neighbors, and most of those links add redundancy rather than signal. LENS gives each edge a learnable gate, a Gumbel-Sigmoid with temperature annealing, and an L0 penalty closes the gates that do not help. On the CPTAC lung cancer set it removes 78% of edges and stays competitive. The edges that remain show which tissue it relied on.
